page.layout: One column of text, with a short centred italic quotation set apart in the middle of the page. No printed marginal notes are visible; only small marks in the margins, described under notes.

main_text.p: eft in Christo, cum novam creaturam esse statuamus, & patris nobiscum vitæ dignitatisque consortem. Non fum nescius Hebræam vocem aliter exponi vulgò, & ad solam quantitatem (ut vocant) difcretam referri plurimùm, cuius ratione cöftat nos omnes, qui diuifi fumus alij ab aliis, vocati in corporis illius vnitatem. Veruntamen cùm rem introfpicio diligentiùs, non poffum quin ad quantitatem quoque (ut vocant) continuam hanc vocem referam, & hoc in loco intelligam conuenientiffimam æqualitatem noftra omnium, in fummo illo beneficio Christi participando hac voce declarari, ut in ftructura iufta omnes partes ad dignitatem & fit-mitatē operis funt fuo modo æquabiles. Quæ doctrina plurimum momenti ad cōfensionem & pacem inter eos quos Christus Ecclesiæ fuæ accenfuit, & porrò vocaturus eft, alendam & continendam adiicit. Atque hæc caufa eft, cur pariter potiùs quàm ut[?] vifum fuerit Hebræam vocem reddere.

p.i: 4. Nam illuc ascendunt tribus, tribus Iah, ad testimonium Israeli datum, ut celebrent nomen Iehoua.

main_text.p: POSTQVAM de forma essentiali Ecclesiæ diximus, & communione interna sanctorum, quam illa relatio Ecclesiæ ad Deum, ut for-mae essentialis efficit; nunc pro eo ordine quem sapien-

page.notes: Small marks in the left margin (a dot near the line "doctrina", an asterisk-like sign near "dignitatis") and a thin rule along the right edge: these are not printed text. The first line of the second paragraph and the verse quotation are italic and centred. Doubtful readings: "cöftat" and "cöfenfionem" (ö may be a printer's mark), "ut[?] vifum" (the word before "vifum" is hard to read; it may be "vt" or "vnà"), and "mae essentialis" where the line ends on "maeffentialis". Long s has been written as plain s throughout, and ligatures such as "st" were read as "st".
